# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: Mobile side-view open-world survival sandbox with crafting, harvesting, enemies, day/night pressure, inventory, and respawn.
- objective: Explore a block terrain, mine resources, collect drops, craft useful items, place materials/torches, fight spawning enemies, and survive the shift.
- input model: Left virtual joystick moves and aims; right action button mines, places, or attacks at the aimed tile; jump button hops; inventory and crafting buttons open modal panels.
- core loop: Spawn into generated terrain, traverse with gravity/platform collision, aim at nearby blocks/enemies, hold action to mine or use selected item, collect drops, craft, endure night enemy pressure, recover after damage/respawn.
- fail/friction state: Enemies damage the five-heart player; reaching zero hearts resets position/time/enemies while keeping the game loop alive. Bedrock and invalid targets block actions.

## Protected mechanics
- Tile size, block map, procedural terrain, gravity, collision categories, joystick movement/aim, jump impulse, action reach/raycast, mining hardness/progress, drops, inventory selection, crafting recipes, placement rules, enemy spawning/chasing/contact damage, hearts, day/night darkness, respawn semantics, and mobile modal paths.

## Remixed target
A portrait-first gothcore survival game called **Pillow Hex Survival Game**, where a vampire-sleepover coven kid explores an analog-horror open world of quilted haunted terrain, mines cursed craft scraps, fights glitch familiars, places nightlights/wards, crafts ritual gear, and survives meme-toned lore drops without changing the original survival sandbox rules.
